name: paper-collage-video
description: Create editable paper-collage and hand-drawn explainer videos with deterministic motion directing, registered limited-animation states, context-preserving pose-sheet recovery, risk-ranked proof rendering, and a self-contained Remotion workspace.

interface.shortDescription: 用导演路由、注册状态动画和风险证明制作纸片视频
interface.longDescription: 初始化独立的 Remotion 工作区，用 Storyboard v4 逐节拍导演 treatments、确定性效果路由、图片与动作双预算、注册式有限动画、一次生成多状态且保持整表上下文的姿态表、可编辑文字/形状节点、风险排序样片、语义契约、增量合成证据和音频预检，完成可恢复的纸片拼贴与手绘解释视频制作。
